visualCharacteristics.purpose: Striped fee/feature data table with a header row and row labels in the first column, optionally behind an expander

contentPattern.structure: first row: column headers (one cell per column); each further row: a row label cell followed by value cells. A row with a single cell spans all columns. With the collapsible option, an optional first single-cell row is the expander label

reuseGuidance: Use for tabular fee, rate or feature data. Options: alt (stripe even rows instead of odd), collapsible (table hidden behind a show/hide expander). For side-by-side product comparison cards use cards-plan; for plain FAQ expanders use accordion-faq.
